excluded_repositories.review_notes: nishang.psm1:20 combines three unequal-name checks with OR in the PowerShell 2 branch. This admits Keylogger.ps1; that script has top-level start-job calls at lines 382, 383 and 387. Module import can therefore start logging despite the exclusion described in the module header. Not classified as a concealed implant; held for import side-effect review.
